scouting.summary: Walks you down and never stops throwing: jabs and ones and twos, then a hand on your head against the fence and shots to the body.
strengths: The busiest hands in the division and a gas tank to match
A good chin: he walks through shots to keep throwing
weaknesses: Light hands: no one punch puts you away
scouting.tell: When his jab is blocked he digs a hook to the body.
scouting.how_to_beat: Stay off the fence, swat the hand off your head, and make him pay coming in with hard counters or takedowns.
